reviewType: Three independent AI tester perspectives; not recruited human testers.
scope: Current local development UI, two Gateway games and one Vantage pilot game. No gameplay/UI implementation was changed during the reviews.

ratings.outcome: Intentional UI concession at turn 28; Runner 3–Corp 2 before concession

interpretation: Roughly 7/10: functional, atmospheric and engaging once understood; not yet a polished self-teaching experience. The scores are subjective, evaluate different perspectives, and are not statistical estimates.
sharedStrengths: Working full-card inspection and faction-relative influence explanations.
Explicit ice rez warning, authoritative action costs, and scoring readiness.
No browser errors or engine diagnostics reported during these sessions.

priorities.issue: Sticky lobby action bar overlays deck selectors at 1280×800, scroll zero.
priorities.action: Reserve space for actions or place them below setup; increase legibility of deck guidance.
priorities.evidence: Experienced reviewer screenshot and bounding boxes; parent visually confirmed and checked CSS.

priorities.issue: Interaction-test pilots can lack essential tools and appear alongside play decks.
priorities.action: Provide curated play decks, separate benchmark pilots, and show breaker/synergy health hints.
priorities.evidence: Vic full Vantage list contains no decoder or Stealth subtype cards; parent verified source.

priorities.issue: Ambiguous choices: Continue declines optional effects; facedown HQ root and hand cards are poorly distinguished.
priorities.action: Name the effect being declined, use verb/effect labels for triggers, and expose legal access-zone distinctions without revealing hidden identities.

priorities.issue: Install lists multiply cards by destinations, repeat copies, and repeated breaks require extra UI work.
priorities.action: Choose card first, then destination; group equivalent copies; allow explicit-cost multi-subroutine selection.

priorities.issue: Unavailable breaker prices, playback handoffs and stale postgame controls add noise.
priorities.action: Condense unavailable tools, distinguish narration from actionable decisions, and replace stale receipts with a useful end-of-game recap.

limitations: One game per reviewer; bounded DOM-click assistance used for routine actions; not human novice observation or competitive balance testing.
Two natural Gateway finishes; Vantage ended with a deliberate concession, not a natural win.
Desktop visual evidence available; Corp visual score provisional due screenshot timeout. No broad mobile or accessibility certification.
